about: Chat regression suite for POST /api/ask (scripts/chat-suite/run.mjs). Every expected fact names its source: a document id and page read through the live API on October 11, 2026 (/api/documents/<id>/text, /api/votes, /api/meetings, /api/people, /api/construction, captured by the Diagnostics workflow runs 38131489865 and 38131647112 on the diagnostics branch), or a portal data record when the fact has no document (directory, meeting calendar, GIS map, construction page). Items with kind 'behavior' check how the answer is built, not a fact. Items with 'until' are only checked up to that date (Utah time); time-dependent answers are checked against live data with 'live'. Cases added October 11, 2026 read the live API through Diagnostics run 38152760553 (October 11, 2026) (votes, records indexes, meetings, people, fee schedule search). Every answer must open a portal page and never dead-end ("couldn't find", "unavailable", "unable to", "I don't know"); off-topic and small talk are the only answers without a source. Cases in category 'tone' (added October 11, 2026, questions written for the suite, none taken from residents' chats) grade tone and helpfulness with 'tone' (scripts/chat-suite/lib.mjs toneChecks): no records-disclaimer opener, not only record quotes, an explanation sentence when the question asks why or what something means ('tone.explain'), and never the paused line while /api/health reports AI healthy and the tests bucket unspent.
